decisions.reason: The source changes the permitted presentation methods for the stamped concurrence package, not the scope or intended outcome of the electrical review.
The choice between a stamped cover letter and stamped redlined sheets does not change the Nevada PE name or license number.
The source concerns final concurrence-package presentation and does not waive or modify the documentation needed to verify the physical changes.
The source concerns the Nevada as-built concurrence package and does not resolve or modify the separate California PE credential requirement.
The approved concurrence presentation options apply to the Nevada as-built review, not the separate additional-project permit-ready electrical drawing package.
Changing how concurrence is documented does not change the electrical calculations required for the separate permit-design project.
The source does not address or alter the Manual J, Manual S, Manual D, HVAC-sizing, or Title 24 calculation requirements.
